text_block_list.text:
On my way home from shopping with
Biwa
Hayahide, we hear lively singing
coming from
somewhere.

Judging by the poster over there, it
looks like a
concert's being held nearby.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Flying in from out of nowhere,
it's
Tokaaai Teiooo!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Everyone's so hyped up!
We're
not losing to you, though! ♪
text_block_list.name: Idols

text_block_list.text:
T-Teio? What is she doing up there,
dancing with
those idols?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Did you see how she moved? She was so
elegant
and expressive... She fits right in
with the other
professionals on stage.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: She was definitely pretty into it.

text_block_list.text: Ngh... I feel so ashamed of myself.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Compared to her, I'm stiff as a board
when I
dance. There's no way my clumsy
moves are
conveying my gratitude to the
fans...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There must be some trick to being able
to dance
so well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Why don't you try dancing with her?

text_block_list.text: Of course! That's a great idea!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Your performance was superb, Teio. I
enjoyed it
immensely.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! Hehe! Seeing them
dance made
me all giddy, so I decided
to jump on up there!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You truly did! I was wondering if—no,
wait. I need
to approach this more
respectfully...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Miss Teio, would you please teach me
the secret
to dancing confidently?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: "Miss Teio"?! Aw, gosh, you don't have to be that respectful! But I guess I am a pretty good dancer...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Please, I implore you! You must teach
me how to
dance without looking like
I'm made out of wood!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You're not... really made out of wood,
are you?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but whatever! For
starters,
why don't you show me some
moves?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Uh... Right here?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm your teacher now, so you gotta
listen to
me! Come on, copy my steps!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: A-am I doing this correctly?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you! You definitely seem
like the
real deal to me! Your height
makes your moves
super dynamic too!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You've got a lot going for you, so don't
worry! As
your teacher, I think you'll be
fine as long as you
polish up those skills
of yours!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I understand now... So I have my very
own way of
expressing myself!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you want to go up and dance too?

Nice! Go ahead! You can do it!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: W-wait, I never said I wanted to—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide! Let me guess. You can't
resist the
beat either, huh?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Yay! Come on, show us your moves!
Get
over here and let's gooo!
text_block_list.name: Idols

text_block_list.text: Gah! How did this happen?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My heart is filled with so much
love, love,
looove!
All for you, you,
youuu! Woo! ♪
text_block_list.name: Idols

text_block_list.text: W-woo...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Awww, you're sooo cute! C'mon, you've
gotta
dance with everyone!
Encore!
Encore!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that was fun! Nothing relaxes me
like a good
dance sesh!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо
choice_data_list: You were both fantastic up there.

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... You really... think so? I actually got... pretty absorbed in it, myself...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You were perfect! All the fans loved you! Dancing is all about feeling!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Think about it—the reason why we
dance at our
winning concerts is because
we want to make our
fans happy, right?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Ah! Yes, now that you mention it...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hm... I guess the secret to dancing
confidently
was inside me the whole
time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Токай Тэйо's encouragement
and help,
Biwa Hayahide's dance moves
improve greatly!

Бива Хаяхидэ's worries melt away, and
her dance
moves improve greatly.
